name: Gakuen of the Dead
original_name: 学園・オブ・ザ・デッド
source:
My name is Tsutsumi Mamoru and I have just recently been reunited with my childhood friend Makabe Akane that I have not seen in three years.

Standing on the roof of the school, she confesses to me her love and we seal our love to each other with a kiss.

But, all of a sudden zombies begin to overrun the city attacking anyone in sight. Within a matter of minutes they overran the school that both of them were standing on the roof of in the town.

At the same time Akane's father calls to tell them that a similar incident happened in the past due to the zombies being controlled by girls known as "Queens." He also explains the only way to stop the zombies is to defeat the "Queens" and where the evacuation is taking place for the survivors.

With this information in tow, we set out to escape the city by getting to the evacuation point in town.
translation:
我叫堤守，最近刚与分别三年的青梅竹马真壁茜重逢。

在学校屋顶上，她向我告白，我们用亲吻封存了彼此的爱。

然而，城市突然被僵尸大军淹没，它们攻击视野内的一切目标。短短几分钟，连我们所在学校的屋顶也被僵尸占领。

与此同时，茜的父亲打来电话，告诉我们过去曾发生过类似事件：僵尸是由被称为“女王”的女孩控制的。他还解释说，阻止僵尸的唯一方法就是击败“女王”，并告知幸存者的撤离地点。

带着这些信息，我们出发前往城镇中的撤离点，试图逃离这座城市。
